title.en: AI Coding Brief: Claude Fable 5.2 & Mythos 5.2 land everywhere

description.en: Anthropic's new flagships hit Claude Code and GitHub Copilot the same week, Copilot expands to Xcode and JetBrains Air, VS Code 1.145 makes the Copilot harness the default, and Codex CLI adds Vertex AI setup.

text.en: Claude Fable 5.2 & Mythos 5.2 launch as new flagships
Claude Code defaults to Fable 5.2, adds remote-control
Copilot lands in Xcode and JetBrains Air
VS Code 1.145 makes the Copilot harness the default
Codex CLI adds Vertex AI setup and no-daemon agents

title.en: Claude Fable 5.2 becomes the default Fable model

body_html.en: v2.1.321 makes Claude Fable 5.2 the default Fable model and adds new remote-control and VS Code options, alongside 15 improvements and 74 bug fixes.

title.en: MCP task support lands in the terminal

body_html.en: v2.1.319 adds MCP task support in the terminal and a permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting setting, with 16 improvements and 90 bug fixes.

title.en: Mod forks get an effort option; IDE auto-install stops

body_html.en: v2.1.318 adds an effort option for mod forks and loginExpiresAt in claude auth status, and stops the IDE extension from auto-installing inside IDE terminals.
v2.1.322 adds fast mode on Vertex AI across the global, US and EU regions, falling back to standard speed if Vertex refuses it.

title.en: Codex CLI adds Vertex AI setup and daemon-free agents

body_html.en: Release 0.167.0 adds a codex agents --no-daemon option, a Google Cloud Vertex AI setup flow, and system proxy settings under /experimental.

title.en: Claude Fable 5.2 arrives in GitHub Copilot

body_html.en: GitHub Copilot adds Claude Fable 5.2 as a selectable model across its plans.

title.en: @GitHub in Slack and Teams goes GA

body_html.en: @GitHub in Slack and Microsoft Teams is now generally available, alongside a weekly Copilot release roundup.

title.en: Copilot reaches Xcode and JetBrains Air

body_html.en: GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode's coding assistant (Nov 4) and in JetBrains Air (Nov 3), extending its IDE footprint beyond VS Code and JetBrains' mainline IDEs.

title.en: VS Code 1.145 makes the Copilot harness the default

body_html.en: The Copilot harness, running on the Copilot SDK through the Agent Host, is now the default for new chat sessions. The release also adds cron-scheduled local automations, remote agents and canvases (preview), and mixed agent harnesses for nested sessions.

notes.en: New public flagship, pitched for coding, finance and the sciences; became the default Fable model in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot the same week.
Companion flagship announced alongside Fable 5.2, aimed at the most demanding technical work.
Alibaba teased "the becoming begins" on Nov 6; a Max/Plus/Flash hosted lineup plus a 27B open-weight model were previewed in September but no ship date is confirmed.
Moonshot's 3T-parameter, 1M-context model launched in late October; full open weights were promised by Nov 4 but had not appeared as of the latest reports.

notable_trends.en: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2 launch was the week's one confirmed model release, and it propagated fast: Claude Code defaulted to it and GitHub Copilot added it within 24 hours of the Anthropic announcement.
GitHub Copilot's week was about reach, not models — Xcode, JetBrains Air, and GA for @GitHub in Slack/Teams — while VS Code 1.145 quietly made the Copilot SDK-based harness the default agent runtime.
The Chinese labs stayed in teaser mode: Qwen 4 got a cryptic one-line hint and Kimi K3.1 Pro's promised open weights still hadn't shipped, so this week's model news was almost entirely a US story.
